subject.title: fix(ci): repair LOC and dead-code ratchets

question: Should the LOC-ratchet repair land from this narrower three-file branch or from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105981, which also includes sidebar cleanup?
rationale: Both branches contain the central repair, and the replacement claim predates later updates to this branch; choosing the permanent scope and canonical branch requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep the narrow branch
options.body: Update this PR to LOC-only scope, rebase and regenerate the baseline, rerun exact-base guards, and remove the duplicated repair from the other branch.

options.title: Use the replacement branch
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105981 canonical after reviewing its additional sidebar changes, then resolve this branch without landing duplicate logic.

recommendation.title: Keep the narrow branch
recommendation.body: Update this PR to LOC-only scope, rebase and regenerate the baseline, rerun exact-base guards, and remove the duplicated repair from the other branch.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored most current repair commits and actively managed both overlapping branches.
